lines: Perumal Ramamurthy Srinivasan, an Investor Selling Shareholder, may sell up to 6,750 shares in the offer for sale, for proceeds up to ₹0.91 crore if all offered shares are sold.
The timing is at listing, with trading start printed as March 11, 2026, so the call is timely now.
Gain is up to ₹0.67 crore before offer expenses and taxes; retained holding is ₹2.13 crore (estimate, valued at offer price).
Confidence is medium: name verified in the seller table, holdings found in one section only (promoter_holding). Family link: unknown.
